name: AetherMesh
description: A precise infrastructure website with a physical chrome network lattice, five-region explorer, five-language code examples and a restrained cobalt identity.

name: Lumina Academy
description: A warm independent academy with a three-dimensional open book, readable art and design lessons, optional spoken passages and a working three-question reflection.

name: CyberForge '26
description: A bold maker-weekend website with a kinetic modular sculpture, large poster typography, selectable challenge tracks, local team shortlists and a maker-pass generator.

name: Kenji Takahashi
description: A quiet Tokyo designer portfolio with physical brass chimes, real synthesized notes, three detailed case studies, a visitor stamp and an email-draft contact form.

name: Atelier Aura
description: A tactile object shop with a physically rendered lamp, three selectable material finishes, a light switch, product filters, monogram studies and a working local shopping bag.

name: Nordic Tech Summit '26
description: A typographic Copenhagen conference website with a layered 3D architectural sculpture, day and stage programme filters, session details and a local ticket-pass generator.

name: System 95 Auth
description: Authentic 1995 vintage desktop OS with classic grey plastic bevels (#c0c0c0), Windows blue titlebars (#000080), 56k V.90 dial-up modem handshake simulation with hardware LEDs, and Start taskbar.

name: Braun & Rams Atelier
description: Pure Dieter Rams functionalist industrial monograph with matte chalk (#eae8e3) and signal orange (#ff5500) palette, interactive aluminum rotary dial knob with detent click, and 10 Principles of Good Design drawer.

name: SHIBUYA 00
description: High-contrast Tokyo streetwear drop engine with pitch black and solar acid yellow (#fff000) palette, live millisecond countdown ticker, scarcity size inventory selector, and slide-over checkout bag.

name: AeroTrack
description: Oceanic air traffic control radar deck with flight navy (#020611) and aviation emerald palette, live interactive rotating radar canvas with selectable flight vectors, altitude tape gauges, and METAR weather decoder.

name: Æthelgard Horlogerie
description: Geneva master watchmaker atelier with Cinzel and Cinzel Decorative typography, oscillating tourbillon balance wheel with acoustic metronome synthesizer, synodic lunar complication dial, 4-tier layer dissection, and bespoke metallurgy configurator.

name: Komorebi Sukiya
description: Kyoto Higashiyama architectural hermitage featuring Syne and Fraunces typography, dynamic time-of-day sun dial casting real chiaroscuro shadows through shoji louvers, interactive water basin ripple pond, and 5-stage Chado tea liturgy.

name: Vektorform Modular
description: Hardware analog waveform synthesizer with Unbounded and Bricolage Grotesque typography, REAL browser Web Audio API oscillator keyboard, live CRT phosphor oscilloscope canvas, 16-step modular drum grid, and Eurorack patch bay.

name: Atelier Vénus
description: Parisian haute couture atelier with Fraunces italic and Syne typography, 360° rotational silhouette drapery metrology with cut architecture wireframes, interactive fabric sheen shader, and private fitting salon booking.
